title: zh-CN metadata forms served by the platform still say 仪表板 where the Console now says 仪表盘
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpFBMr917PmVkG9up7

Carries item 4 (the platform half) of #30039. #30039 keeps items 1–3 and 5, and its ui half of item 4, in PR #30163.

Filing gate: ① (a user-visible product defect with a named producer).

## Business reason

A Chinese admin reads 仪表盘 in the Console and Studio: rail, menu, create dialog, publish sheet, and the forms the Console localizes itself after PR #30163. The dashboard authoring form that the platform localizes still says 仪表板. One object carries two names inside one flow of work, which is what #30039 item 4 set out to end: 「One word for dashboard across zh-CN Console and Studio text: 仪表盘」.

## Reach

Named producer: `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts` holds 仪表板 on 6 lines (1398, 1402, 1447, 1451, 1455 and 1475 on `origin/main`, re-check below). `rest-server.ts` localizes the `/api/v1/meta/types` forms with that bundle (`MetadataFormsTranslations`), reported by the dev of PR #30163. The seat did not measure this through the door.

## Reader who acts

Triage routes this card; it is not labelled `domain:*`. The file is `.generated`, so the fix belongs at whatever source `packages/platform-objects/scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` builds it from, and then a regeneration.

## Acceptance

1. Every zh-CN platform metadata-form string for dashboard reads 仪表盘.
2. The generated bundle is regenerated from its source, never hand-edited.

## Dedupe (open and closed)

`仪表板 is:issue`: 169 hits, none about the platform bundle (nearest: #30039, #27419). `zh-CN dashboard 仪表盘 is:issue`: 6 hits, same. `metadata-forms.generated 仪表板 is:issue`: 0. **New.**

## Re-check

`git grep -c "仪表板" origin/main -- packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts`
